title: Novomoskovsk
summary: Novomoskovsk refers to several locations and entities, primarily highlighting the town [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]]'s Dnipropetrovsk Oblast and its historical significance.

sections.heading: Novomoskovsk in Ukraine
paragraphs: Samar, a town located in [[dnipropetrovsk-oblast|Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]], [[ukraine|Ukraine]], was formerly known as Novomoskovsk. This town is significant within the context of Ukraine's administrative divisions and local governance.

sections.heading: Novomoskovsk in Russia
paragraphs: Novomoskovsk is also the name of a city situated in Tula Oblast, Russia. This city is part of the Novomoskovsk Urban Okrug, which serves as its municipal formation.

sections.heading: Military Reference
paragraphs: The term Novomoskovsk is associated with the Russian Navy submarine K-407 Novomoskovsk, which adds a military dimension to the name's significance.
